source.citation: GIAMIP experiment protocol v2.4, dated 2026-09-08. Lead: Holly Han.

forcing.$comment: Protocol section 2.1: only grounded ice loads the solid Earth, so floating ice is masked out.

earth.compressibility: group's choice, recorded in the model report
earth.$comment: Labelled 'Within suggested range' in the protocol table. Choose values inside giamip/resources/models/giamip-open-range.json and record them in the model report.

topography.$comment: GEBCO 2024 outside the polar regional datasets.

period.resolution: 500 years before 26 ka, 100 years from 26 ka onward

constants.$comment: Protocol section 8. These differ from the benchmark values of 931 and 1000.

reference_frame: centre of mass of the whole Earth system (CM), not the solid Earth alone (CE)

gadopt.$comment: Decided by the G-ADOPT team for its own runs. These values fill fields that protocol v2.4 leaves open and do not change what the protocol asks of other groups.
